name: The Eredar Twins: Lady Sacrolash and Alythess
shortDescription: The Eredar Twins: Lady Sacrolash and Alythess, represented in the Shattered Sun and Sunwell research story.
body: One paired representation for the single named raid encounter; not two separate event claims or a claim of co-presence outside that encounter. Original image-generation art; not canonical game art or proof of exact appearance, costume, size or simultaneous presence. Compare it with the Burning Crusade patch-2.4 client/model before human review. See docs/research/shattered-sun-sunwell-visual-assets.json.
